shots.p: wide shot of night spreading darkness over a sleeping desert village, stars appearing
wide shot of daylight breaking brightly over the same village, shadows retreating
wide shot of a married couple, man and woman in hijab, walking side by side on a beach at sunset
split composition: a man laboring only for gold in a market, another man giving charity and praying, different strivings
medium shot of a man handing a bag of food to a poor family at their door, humble and sincere
close-up on the same man's peaceful face as he raises his finger in testimony of faith at dawn
wide shot of the same man walking an easy bright path through green fields, doors opening for him
medium shot of a rich man clutching his purse and refusing a beggar, cold and arrogant
close-up of the same rich man scoffing with a dismissive gesture, dark shadows on his face
wide shot of the rich man walking a rough rocky path into a dark storm, every step harder
wide shot of the rich man's gold coins scattered in the sand at the edge of a cliff, useless to him
wide shot of a clear sunlit path leading through a valley, signposted by sunrise, guidance made plain
wide shot of the whole earth from a mountaintop at sunset, worldly lands under a vast sky, everything owned by its Lord
wide shot of fierce blazing flames at night on a distant horizon, a warning glow, no people
medium shot of a man turning away in denial from a gathering, walking toward fiery red horizon
medium shot of a man turning his back to a reminder and leaving, arrogant stride
wide shot of a pious man walking safely away from a distant fire toward a green valley
medium shot of the pious man quietly giving money to a needy family, purifying his wealth
close-up of the pious man giving a gift secretly to a stranger who never did him any favor
medium shot of the pious man praying alone on a hilltop at dawn, sincere and humble
close-up of the pious man's smiling contented face bathed in soft golden light
